questions.q: What is the smallest prime number?
questions.explanation: 2 has exactly two factors, 1 and 2, and it is the smallest prime.

questions.q: Which of these numbers is prime?
questions.explanation: 29 has only the factors 1 and 29. The others are divisible by 3.

questions.q: What is the prime factorisation of 36?

questions.explanation: 1 has only one factor, so it is neither prime nor composite.

questions.q: Which pair is a pair of twin primes?
questions.explanation: Twin primes differ by 2 and are both prime. 11 and 13 qualify.

questions.q: Which pair of numbers is co-prime?
questions.explanation: 8 and 15 have no common factor other than 1.
